# mevspace_dedicated_servers (Data Source)

Dedicated servers in the account. id is the hostname when present.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mevspace_dedicated_servers" "all" {}

output "servers" {
  value = { for s in data.mevspace_dedicated_servers.all.items : s.id => s.attributes.status }
}
```
